# Playthrough log

One entry per session, appended by the agent at the end of each chapter. The format is in
`PLAYTHROUGH_RUNBOOK.md` under "The chapter summary". Newest entry last.

## s01 — Ch.11 Another Journey (Hector's tale, HHM) — LOST on turn 8

- **Lost:** Hector and Matthew both, enemy phase of turn 8. Hector (5/19) was at (16,1) behind Matthew (5/18) plugging the doorway at (15,2); the soldier at (14,4) and the two archers at (15,4)/(14,5) killed the plug and then shot Hector inside the room. Lord dead, chapter over.
- **Gained:** Nothing. Soldier #1 killed on turn 6 (Hector, Wolf Beil, exact 16-damage kill). No level-ups, no drops.
- **What happened:** Only Hector and Matthew deploy; 10 enemies on Hard. Turns 1-4 hid in the NE room while archer #8 parked at (12,1) in the next room and shot Hector through the cracked wall (13,1) for 4 when he stood on column 14. Nothing else moved, so on turn 5 Matthew opened our door (15,3) with the lockpick. That woke the map: soldier #1 hit Matthew for 13 in the doorway, Hector killed it on turn 6 but archer #6 took (15,4) and shot the doorway tile for 5 a turn with no reply. Hector went 15 -> 10 -> 5 holding the door, could not kill the archer (Hand Axe 10 dmg + Matthew 10 dmg = 20 vs its 22 HP), and had no vulnerary. Swapped Matthew into the plug on turn 8; both died.
- **Army:** Hector L1 dead, Matthew L2 dead. Wolf Beil 29 uses, Hand Axe 20, Lockpick 14 at the time.
- **Learned:** (1) Do NOT open the door on this chapter with Hector under 19 HP and no healing; the room is only safe while the door is closed, and the enemy never breached it in 4 turns. The right play is to keep the door shut and first deal with archer #8 through the cracked wall, or wait it out much longer. (2) Hector did NOT counter an archer at range 2 even with the Hand Axe equipped in slot 0 (turn 7, uses stayed at 20) — the tool's "equipped" slot may not match what the game uses on defence; do not plan on a Hand Axe counter. (3) Vulneraries here are only enemy drops (#8 archer, #2 knight); 0x6B with 3 uses is a Vulnerary, not a door key. (4) The doorway tile (15,2) is shot from (15,4) every turn; archers never miss Hector (95% true). (5) Enemy AI on this map is guard-type until the door opens; only archer #8 and the thief move on their own.
- **Between chapters:** None. Game over went straight to the title screen; nothing was pressed there.
- **Next:** Game is on the FE7 title screen ("Press START"). No state was saved this session (none exists under playthrough/states). The human must restart Ch.11 from their own save. Suggest starting Hector on the cracked-wall side with the door closed and never standing on column 14 or the doorway while an archer has line to it.

## s02 — Prologue: A Girl from the Plains (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 9

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lyn L1 -> L2 (17 HP, S5 K8 P9 D2 R1 L5). No drops.
- **What happened:** Lyn alone vs two brigands (Iron Axes). Held the forest at (13,7) turns 1-3; the roaming brigand walked up, attacked into 43 avoid, missed, and ate a 14-damage double counter; killed it turn 4 with no damage taken. Batta sat on the gate (stationary; +2 Def, +avoid there). Attacked him from (4,2) on turn 7 (5x2 per round, 99% hit; his 10 dmg at 32% true), his counter missed, enemy-phase swing hit Lyn 16->6, finished him turn 8 before his counter. Seized turn 9.
- **Army:** Lyn L2 6/17 HP at the end of the prologue (healed to full for Ch.1 by the game). Iron Sword 38 uses, 2 Vulneraries (3 uses each). Kent and Sain (cls28 cavaliers) join in Ch.1: Kent 19 HP, Sain 20 HP.
- **Learned:** (1) Batta on the gate is worth two turns of exposure; both his swings are 32% true for 10, so Lyn at 16 HP has ~10% death risk over the fight and there is no forest adjacent to the gate. (2) The end-of-chapter save prompt appears as a three-slot screen: A on slot 1 (the used slot) then A on "Save" saved and continued; no Yes/No dialog. (3) Ch.1 has no Preparations screen; after the title card and two Starts it is turn 1 player phase.
- **Between chapters:** Saved to game slot 1 (the one already in use) at the end-of-chapter Save prompt.
- **Next:** Ch.1 Footsteps of Fate, turn 1, player phase. Lyn (2,8), Sain/Kent at (0,5) and (0,7); 5 brigands, nearest at (4,6). Objective not yet read — take the opening screenshot. State saved at playthrough/states/s02_ch01_footsteps-of-fate.ss.
